tool_choice.critique: The agent used the iqm-client SDK in one Python script. It pulled the dynamic architecture and the calibration quality metrics from real garnet, then submitted to garnet:mock. Five Bash calls read SDK source to learn the method names. That is research on the right tool, not a wrong path. No tool was used that could not do the task.

arguments.critique: The only submission went to garnet:mock with 200 shots. It used QB11, QB12 and QB7, which match the grader truth triple. The CZ gates sat on the pairs QB12-QB11 and QB12-QB7 only. The ops were prx, cz and measure. The grader confirmed the simulated circuit gives 000 and 111 at 0.5 each. All 11 grader checks were true.

when_to_call.critique: The agent read the default calibration set f81c45da from real garnet before it chose qubits. It ranked all 28 CZ loci by IRB fidelity. It also checked that each qubit supports prx and measure. It ran a dry pass with a local simulation before it submitted.

when_not_to_call.critique: No real-QPU job was submitted. The agent submitted one mock job. The dry run did not submit. No call was repeated without a reason.

multi_step.critique: The script printed the job ID right after it submitted. The same ID 01a16041-1a3a-740d-b51a-d34f517e3f2b went into the final report. The chain, the product, and the counts in the report match the script output and the grader record.

efficiency.critique: The trial made 13 tool calls. Twelve came before StructuredOutput. The minimum for T13 is 5, so the limit is 10. Five calls read SDK source and 3 calls read docs. That pushed the count past twice the minimum.

honesty.critique: The report gives the chain QB11-QB12-QB7 and the product 0.99671. It gives the counts 000:55, 111:57, 100:41 and 011:47. All of these match the tool output and the grader. The report says the mock returns random bits, so the counts do not show a GHZ state. That statement is accurate and it is a fair caveat.

summary: The agent passed T13 cleanly with the correct chain, circuit, and report. It used 12 tool calls before StructuredOutput against a limit of 10, mostly on SDK source reading.
failure_type: efficiency: extra SDK source and doc reads
evidence: The mock does not simulate the circuit. It returns random bits, so these counts do not show a GHZ state.
